summary: Phase 1 OEM 'Find Tyre by Vehicle' backend fully tested. 29/29 pytest cases PASSED (100%). All 5 user-critical invariants verified: total=450, all 450 rows are OEM VERIFIED, exactly 172 uncategorised rows, category breakdown matches the expected 14-bucket distribution exactly, and original tyre-size strings are preserved (215/60 R17 for Hyundai CRETA Electric 42 kWh returned verbatim). Every /api/oem/* endpoint listed in the review returned the expected shape and values. Search-by-size normalisation collapses '215/60 R17', '215/60-R17', '215/60r17' and the URL-encoded variant to the same normalized key and same count. Honda QC1 front!=rear case verified (90/100-10 hits the rear tyre only). Admin listing paginates, sorts, filters by category+make, and flags all 172 needs-review rows with _category_review_required=true and category=null. No write endpoints are exposed under /api/oem/* (POST/PUT/DELETE all return 405/404). Regression checks pass: /api/ returns TyreBook API, /api/status POST, /api/purchases/check-duplicate, /api/purchases/index, and /api/ocr/invoice schema validation all healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:250 - app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware) is called AFTER app.include_router(). FastAPI still applies middleware globally at request time so this works, but conventionally middleware should be added before routes for clarity.
oem_router.py:279 - needs_review Query default is None but 'ge=1' style constraint absent; note that FastAPI parses 'true'/'false' strings correctly - verified working.
server.py:161 - `logger` is referenced inside scan_invoice but defined at module bottom (line 261). Works at call time due to late binding but is fragile - move logger init above the endpoints.
oem_router.py: search-by-size uses min_length=2 on the query param which is a bit lenient (accepts e.g. '  '), but the normalize_size() check catches empty results with 400. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 450-row oem_vehicle_fitments collection. Regression test inserts one purchase-index doc (invoice_number=TEST_REGRESSION_INV_1, supplier=TEST_SUP) and one status-check doc (client_name=regtest) - both TEST_ prefixed and safely idempotent (upsert / demo).
